address: Meridian Point Centre, Church Road, Greystones, A63 HD43, Ireland
bio: An elegant, intimate establishment with bold décor and an unusual shopping centre location, this long-standing Indian restaurant continues to deliver eminently satisfying dishes to the residents of its lovely seaside town. There are clearly skill and experience aplenty in the kitchen, evident everywhere from the plump tandoori prawns to the superior naan from a proper tandoor oven. The kulfis for dessert are not to be missed either, with a terrific creamy texture and well-balanced flavours. Chatty, engaging service enhances the appeal....
